chunks: And whatever was in it from ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad ibn Ashīm, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his uncle Muḥammad ibn Abī al-Qāsim, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad ibn Ashīm.

key_terms.أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ: a named transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formal expression of hadith narration
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَشِيمٍ: the narrator to whom this transmission path leads
key_terms.عَنْ عَمِّهِ: from his uncle; identifies a familial link within the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad ibn Ashīm in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad ibn Ashīm. Its significance is bibliographical and related to hadith transmission, documenting how the report reaches that narrator through named intermediaries.
